profile.follow.description: The button of a profile that follows the account.

profile.follow_back.description: The button of a profile of an account that follows the reader, which follows it back.

profile.request_follow.defaultMessage: フォローをリクエスト
profile.request_follow.description: The button of a profile of an account that approves its followers, which asks to follow it.

profile.following.description: The button of a profile of an account the reader follows; pressing it unfollows the account.

profile.requested.description: The button of a profile of an account whose approval the reader's follow request awaits; pressing it withdraws the request.

profile.unblock.description: The button, and the item of a profile's menu, that stops blocking the account.

profile.block.description: The item of a profile's menu that blocks the account.

profile.mute.description: The item of a profile's menu that mutes the account.

profile.unmute.description: The item of a profile's menu, and the action of its muted line, that stops muting the account.

profile.more.description: The button of a profile that opens the menu of what else the reader may do with the account.

profile.open_original.description: The item of a profile's menu, and the action of its line about a remote account, that opens the account's page on its own server.

profile.follows_you.defaultMessage: フォローされています
profile.follows_you.description: The badge beside the handle of an account that follows the reader.

profile.bot.description: The badge beside the name of an automated account.

profile.locked.defaultMessage: フォローには承認が必要です
profile.locked.description: The line of a profile, and the label of the lock beside its name, of an account that approves its followers.

profile.following_count.description: The label of the number of accounts the account follows.

profile.followers_count.description: The label of the number of accounts that follow the account.

profile.joined.description: When the account was created, on its profile. date is the month and the year.

profile.featured.description: The heading of the hashtags the account features on its profile.

profile.tag_posts.description: How many of the account's posts carry a hashtag it features. count is how many.

profile.tabs.description: What the tabs of a profile choose between, for assistive technology.

profile.posts.description: The tab of a profile that shows the account's posts, without its replies.

profile.posts_and_replies.description: The tab of a profile that shows the account's posts and its replies.

profile.media.description: The tab of a profile that shows the account's posts with images or other media.

profile.pinned.description: The line over a post the account pinned to its profile.

profile.remote.defaultMessage: {domain} の情報は一部しか表示されていない可能性があります。
profile.remote.description: The line of a profile of an account on another server. domain is that server's domain name.

profile.blocked.defaultMessage: このアカウントをブロックしています。
profile.blocked.description: The line of a profile of an account the reader blocks.

profile.blocked_posts.defaultMessage: ブロックしている間、投稿は表示されません。
profile.blocked_posts.description: What a profile of an account the reader blocks says in place of its posts.

profile.muted.defaultMessage: このアカウントをミュートしています。タイムラインには投稿が表示されません。
profile.muted.description: The line of a profile of an account the reader mutes.

profile.locked_posts.defaultMessage: ほかの投稿はフォロワーだけが見られます。
profile.locked_posts.description: What a profile of an account that approves its followers says under its posts, to a reader who does not follow it.

profile.loading.defaultMessage: プロフィールを読み込んでいます…
profile.loading.description: What a profile says while the account loads.

profile.failed.defaultMessage: プロフィールを読み込めませんでした。
profile.failed.description: What a profile says when the account could not be found or loaded, beside a button to try again.

profile.title.description: The heading of a profile, for assistive technology, and the document's title. name is the account's display name, handle its @handle.
